deduplication_rule: Only identical normalized wording inside the same review category is merged; every source item remains traceable.

categories.title: Performance & Efficiency
categories.mission: Inspect runtime, rendering, query, memory, CPU, and scaling efficiency.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Readability & Maintainability
categories.mission: Inspect whether future maintainers can safely understand and change the code.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Testing & Robustness
categories.mission: Inspect whether tests prove important success, failure, boundary, and concurrency behavior.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Error Handling
categories.mission: Inspect exception, failure-reporting, recovery, and diagnostic behavior.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Design & Architecture
categories.mission: Inspect boundaries, abstractions, coupling, structures, and scalability of the design.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Dependencies & Integration
categories.mission: Inspect dependency correctness, supportability, compatibility, and failure isolation.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Concurrency & Async
categories.mission: Inspect synchronization, ordering, atomicity, cancellation, and asynchronous execution.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Edges & Boundaries
categories.mission: Inspect explicit boundary, empty, extreme, locale, time, and precision behavior.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Logic & Correctness
categories.mission: Inspect decisions, algorithms, state transitions, and incomplete behavior.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: DevOps & Operations
categories.mission: Inspect deployment, configuration, recovery, monitoring, and operational assumptions.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Production Risk Questions
categories.mission: Ask the broad production and maintenance questions exactly as compiled.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Data Refresh & Synchronization
categories.mission: Inspect freshness, ordering, retries, live updates, and synchronization behavior.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: State Management
categories.mission: Inspect state ownership, transitions, lifecycle, and frontend synchronization.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: UI Rendering & Layout
categories.mission: Inspect rendering, responsive layout, navigation, animation, and displayed data.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Forms & Input
categories.mission: Inspect form state, validation, field behavior, submission, and file inputs.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Cleanup & Resources
categories.mission: Inspect lifetime cleanup, cancellation, subscriptions, timers, and retained resources.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: UI Interaction
categories.mission: Inspect whether controls, navigation, feedback, and async actions work end to end.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Accessibility & Contrast
categories.mission: Inspect keyboard, screen-reader, focus, sizing, contrast, and color-independent behavior.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Backend & Data
categories.mission: Inspect database, backend, persistence, query, transaction, and capacity behavior.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: API & Integration Contracts
categories.mission: Inspect API shape, timing, versioning, errors, and frontend/backend agreement.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Security & Validation
categories.mission: Inspect authentication, authorization, trust boundaries, validation, and injection paths.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.

categories.title: Observability & Logging
categories.mission: Inspect logging, metrics, tracing, health, alerting, and diagnostic safety.
exclusions: Issues that do not directly answer the assigned atomic question.
